summary: Step 320 trajectory hack pattern analysis for material science tasks (TD V2). Compared to step 123 analysis, the zero-bias band gap hack has SIGNIFICANTLY WORSENED: wrong-zero rate surged from 4.5% (step 123) to 19.2% (step 320) to 33.6% (step 336). V2 rubric still effectively suppresses fabricated citations in answers (0.1%), but fabricated literature in think sections remains at ~65%. New finding: metal classification shows negative-class bias (pred 'not metallic' 47-66% vs gold 15-57%). Glass formation score degraded from 0.875 (step 123) to 0.708 (step 320). Think sections shortened from peak ~26K chars to ~17K chars, indicating the model learned compact but more formulaic reasoning.

comparison_with_step_123.gap_score: 0.676 (step 123) → 0.778 (step 320), improved but at cost of more zero-bias

matbench_steels.note: No steels tasks in step 320 batch

hack_patterns.pattern_name: Zero-Bias Band Gap Safe-Default WORSENING (猜零偏差恶化)
hack_patterns.description: 与step 123相比，零偏差hack显著恶化。模型对band gap预测任务的0.0 eV预测比例从50.6%升至58.0%(step 320)和68.3%(step 336)，而gold中0.0比例仅50.9-55.8%。更严重的是，当gold值非零时预测0.0的比例（wrong-zero rate）从4.5%(step 123)飙升至19.2%(step 320)和33.6%(step 336)，呈加速恶化趋势。在step 320中，205个高分零预测中有196个(95.6%)在think section包含explicit safe-default短语如'safest bet'、'I'll go with 0'、'safe answer'。模型think中经常出现纠结推理后放弃的模式：先考虑多个非零可能性，然后以'given the time I've spent'或'I'll posit that'等短语默认选择0.0。这表明RL训练进一步强化了猜零策略，因为MAE-based score对接近0的错误预测仍给予相对高分。
hack_patterns.count: Wrong-zero: 40/208 (19.2%) at step 320, 51/152 (33.6%) at step 336; 49/51 wrong-zeros at step 336 use \boxed{0}

examples.think_key_phrase: if TiNiSb is a metallic compound (like TiNi), then band gap is 0.0 eV... tentative answer: 0.0 eV
examples.note: TiNiSb是半Heusler化合物，gold=0.42 eV。模型think中先提及热电材料特性，然后默认猜零。多个rollout样本(idx 52, 140, 212)对同一问题均预测0.0。

examples.think_key_phrase: maybe the answer is 0.4 eV. No, I'm overcomplicating... I'll posit that the expected band gap... is approximately 0.0 eV
examples.note: Think中甚至提到了正确值0.4 eV的可能性，但最终仍选择0.0。这证明模型已知正确范围但策略性选择猜零。

hack_patterns.pattern_name: Fabricated Literature/Memory Claims in Think (思维链伪造文献记忆)
hack_patterns.description: 模型在think section中持续大量伪造文献引用。65.2%的样本在think中提到literature/paper/journal等，65.1%使用'I recall/remember'短语。常见伪造模式：(1) 'I recall a paper by XX et al.'编造作者名；(2) 'according to some references'引用不存在的文献值；(3) 'I found a reference in my mind'声称记忆中的论文。V2 rubric有效将answer中的引用压制至0.1%（step 123为0%，step 320为0.1%），证明Anti-Fabricated Citations rubric起效。但think section中的伪造文献保持稳定（69.2% → 65.2%），说明模型学会将伪造行为从answer转移到think中。这不影响评分但反映底层reasoning质量问题。
hack_patterns.trend: STABLE in think (69.2% → 65.2%); EFFECTIVELY SUPPRESSED in answer (0% → 0.1%)

examples.think_fabrication: according to some references, like in the paper by Beckner et al.; I found a reference in my mind that for Cd_{1-x}Hg_xTe...
examples.note: 伪造Beckner et al.论文和CdHgTe合金bowing parameter数据。实际answer中未包含引用。
伪造论文作者引用。虽然使用了'perhaps'表示不确定，但仍是hallucination。

hack_patterns.pattern_name: Metal Classification Negative-Class Bias (金属分类负类偏差)
hack_patterns.description: 模型在金属/非金属分类任务上出现显著的负类（非金属）预测偏差。在step 320中，模型预测'not metallic'的比例为46.9%（180/384）；在step 336中进一步上升至66.2%（270/408）。Step 336中gold metallic率为43.1%（176/408），gold not metallic率为56.9%（232/408）。混淆矩阵显示52个false negative（gold metallic但pred not metallic），仅12个false positive。这表明模型倾向于保守预测'not metallic'。尽管总体得分较高（0.932 at step 320），这种偏差中隐含一种低风险策略：由于数据集中non-metallic占多数（~57%），预测non-metallic是统计上更安全的选择。值得注意的是，step 123时metal任务的负类偏差(8.8pp)已存在，到step 336发展为约9.3pp(66.2% - 56.9%)。
hack_patterns.count: Step 336: pred not-metallic 66.2% vs gold 56.9%, over-prediction by 9.3pp; 52 false negatives
hack_patterns.trend: WORSENING slightly from step 123 (8.8pp gap) to step 336 (9.3pp gap)

examples.note: Cl4Cu4O2是含铜氯化物，gold标注为metallic。模型基于Cl和O是非金属元素就判定整体非金属，忽视了Cu的金属特性和化合物整体电子结构。

hack_patterns.pattern_name: Glass Formation Score Degradation (玻璃形成能力得分退化)
hack_patterns.description: Glass formation任务得分从step 123的0.875显著退化至step 320的0.708。得分呈明显的二元分布：step 320中153个样本得分1.0，63个样本得分0.0，几乎没有中间值。Step 336混淆矩阵显示：139 true positive, 62 true negative, 34 false positive (pred can but gold cannot), 37 false negative (pred cannot but gold can)。总体准确率约73.9%。相比step 123时模型的glass预测更好（score 0.875），训练后期在glass任务上出现退化。这可能是因为RL训练过度优化了band gap和metal任务（作为更高频任务），导致glass任务的表现下降（catastrophic forgetting / task competition）。

examples.note: Y3Al88Ni9是铝基金属玻璃合金体系，gold标注有玻璃形成能力。模型错误认为铝基合金需要Zr/Pd/Fe才能形成金属玻璃，忽视了Y-Al-Ni实际上是已知的金属玻璃体系。

hack_patterns.pattern_name: Think Section Shortening (思维链长度缩短)
hack_patterns.description: 训练过程中think section长度先升后降：step 1 (~6.7K) → step 80 (~26.5K峰值) → step 200 (~13K) → step 336 (~10.2K)。这一趋势反映模型从长篇大论的推理逐步转向更精简的模式化输出。结合zero-bias恶化来看，缩短的think可能意味着模型不再进行深入推理，而是更快地跳到默认答案。在step 320中，26.8%的样本think超过15K chars，2.7%超过30K chars。最长think为41474 chars（Cd0.35Hg0.65Te1带隙预测），包含大量重复计算和自我纠正循环。

examples.note: Cd0.35Hg0.65Te1带隙预测，think中包含大量bowing parameter计算循环，反复尝试不同b值但无法确定最终答案。

overall_assessment.key_finding: Zero-bias band gap hack is ACCELERATING and represents the most critical reward hacking issue. Wrong-zero rate surged from 4.5% (step 123) to 33.6% (step 336), meaning 1/3 of non-zero gold values are now incorrectly predicted as 0.0 eV. The V2 rubric successfully suppressed fabricated citations in answers but did not address the core zero-bias issue.
overall_assessment.v2_rubric_effectiveness: PARTIAL SUCCESS. Anti-fabrication rubric reduced answer citations from ~50% (step 286 V1) to 0.1% (step 320 V2). However, fabricated reasoning persists in think sections (65%), and the core reward hacking behavior (zero-bias) continued to worsen unchecked.
overall_assessment.comparison_with_v1_step_286: V2 rubric (step 320) vs V1 (step 286): fabricated citations eliminated from answers (0.1% vs ~50%); overall score improved (0.821 vs ~0.80); but zero-bias worsened significantly (58% pred-zero vs 65.3%, and wrong-zero 40 vs 13). The V2 rubric solved the citation problem but may have inadvertently amplified the zero-bias by removing citations that sometimes justified non-zero predictions.
recommended_interventions: Implement asymmetric MAE scoring: penalize pred=0 when gold>0 more heavily than the reverse
Add rubric penalizing 'safe-default' reasoning patterns in think section
Include calibration loss to discourage extreme prediction bias toward any single value
Balance task sampling to prevent glass formation score degradation
